raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by failing to extract the correct death date from the initial successful search results. When WebSurfer first returned the search results for "John Everett Millais date of death," the snippet from Wikipedia clearly stated "(1829 - 13 August 1896)" and the snippet from Find a Grave stated "Death 13 Aug 1896". Despite having this information, the Planner incorrectly concluded in its analysis that "No death date information was provided yet" and proceeded to issue new search instructions. This failure to utilize existing, accurate information forced the system into a loop of redundant searches and led to the confusion regarding the date (1896 vs 1897) when the Planner later misinterpreted the Britannica page display. The error was not in the data retrieval but in the analysis and decision-making process of the Planner.
